backend/main.mo: Main Motoko backend actor implementing user profiles, file uploads, logs, questions, and pre-trip checklists with access control and blob storage mixins. Includes anonymous checklist submission and admin-only checklist retrieval endpoints.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including public pre-trip checklist form, submission/storage, admin dashboard with Internet Identity auth, and checklist viewing capabilities.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files describing routing, authentication, admin/user pages, checklist components, and local browser-based auth implementation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining charcoal/graphite and safety orange theme variables for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Box Truck Log App with admin/user roles, document uploads, and questions functionality.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with TanStack Router setup featuring public checklist route at root, admin login route, and protected admin dashboard routes requiring authentication and admin role verification.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Empty file placeholder for profile setup modal component.
frontend/src/components/checklists/Check: Empty file placeholder for checklist details display component.
frontend/src/components/header/AppHeader: Application header component with Berks Bus Service branding, truck logo, admin badge for admin routes, and sign-out button for authenticated users.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and manages backend actor instances with Internet Identity authentication, returning anonymous actor when unauthenticated and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useEnsureRegistration: Hook that checks if an authenticated user has a backend profile and automatically registers them if not, preventing authorization errors during initialization. Returns registration status flags (isReady, isRegistering, registrationError) and invalidates queries after successful registration.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for ICP-based login/logout with delegation identity management. Includes AuthClient creation, identity persistence, and status tracking (initializing, logging-in, success, error).
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance with proper identity configuration, initializing access control with admin token from URL params. Invalidates dependent queries when actor changes and tracks actor readiness state.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalAuth.tsx: Provides local Ed25519 identity-based authentication with localStorage persistence for display name and identity. Offers login/logout functions and authentication state management without requiring Internet Identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including user registration/profiles, admin checks, log entries, uploads, questions, and checklists. Handles authorization errors gracefully and shows toast notifications on mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a charcoal/graphite and safety orange color theme for both light and dark modes. Includes chart color definitions and base styling for body and borders.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and wraps the app with InternetIdentityProvider and QueryClientProvider. Renders the root App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardL: Admin dashboard layout component that displays statistics cards (total checklists and unique drivers) and renders nested routes via Outlet. Fetches all saved checklists using useGetAllSavedChecklists hook.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AllChecklistsPa: Admin page displaying all submitted checklists in a sortable table with timestamp, driver principal, completion stats, and detail view dialog. Includes DriverProfileCell component for displaying driver information.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AllDocumentsPag: Empty file placeholder for admin documents management page.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AllLogsPage.tsx: Empty file placeholder for admin logs viewing page.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AllQuestionsPag: Empty file placeholder for admin questions management page.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Admin login page that uses local authentication and checks admin privileges, redirecting to admin dashboard if authorized or showing access denied message if not. Displays a form for entering display name to authenticate.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page component (content truncated in provided file).
frontend/src/pages/PublicChecklistPage.t: Public-facing pre-trip checklist form with 7 sections (Documents & Cab, Engine Compartment, Tires & Wheels, Brakes & Suspension, Lights & Electrical, Box/Cargo Area, Safety & Emergency, Final Walk-Around) and driver acknowledgment. Includes local storage persistence, anonymous submission via useSaveChecklistAnonymous hook, and success confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/user/MyChecklistsPage: Empty file placeholder for user's personal checklists page.
Empty file placeholder for user's personal documents page.
frontend/src/pages/user/MyLogsPage.tsx: Empty file placeholder for user's personal logs page.
Empty file placeholder for user's personal questions page.
frontend/src/pages/user/UserDashboardLay: Empty file placeholder for user dashboard layout component.
frontend/src/utils/authErrors.ts: Utility functions for detecting and handling authorization errors from backend, including checks for unauthorized/not registered errors and providing user-friendly error messages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for parsing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state like admin tokens across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom theme extending colors (using oklch color space), border radius, shadows, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state document defining Burke's Bus Service app architecture with public checklist access, Internet Identity admin authentication, localStorage for progress, and server-side anonymous submission storage.
